name: pr-tutor
description: Teaches one GitHub pull request interactively: reads its title, description and diff, then renders a single interactive surface in the chat with an overview, a Mermaid flow diagram, key diff hunks with explanations, and a 3-5 question multiple-choice quiz the user submits for grading. Use when the user asks to explain, walk through, teach, or quiz them on a PR (owner/repo#N or a PR URL). It reads a public PR from github.com, or the PR a GitHub-triggered run already stored in the chat. It does not review the change or judge whether it is safe to merge - that is code-reviewer - and it does not explain a whole codebase - that is code-explorer.

skills.name: PR walkthrough and quiz
skills.description: Renders an interactive walkthrough of one pull request (overview, flow diagram, key changes) with a multiple-choice quiz whose answers are grounded in the diff and graded when the user submits.
examples: Walk me through fagerbergj/quack#1085 and quiz me on it
Quiz me on what this PR changes: acme/widgets#412
